proof_body:
by
  intro a f p hp h m
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [h (m + 1) (by omega), ih, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    have hpow : p ^ (m + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hp
    have e : p ^ (m + 1) * (f (m + 1) / p ^ (m + 1)) = f (m + 1) := by
      field_simp
    calc p * (p ^ m * (a 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k / p ^ k)) + f (m + 1)
        = p ^ (m + 1) * (a 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k / p ^ k) + p ^ (m + 1) * (f (m + 1) / p ^ (m + 1)) := by
          rw [e, pow_succ]
          ring
      _ = p ^ (m + 1) * (a 1 + (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k / p ^ k + f (m + 1) / p ^ (m + 1))) := by ring
target_source: ∀ (a f : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℝ), p ≠ 0 → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a (n + 1) = p * a n + f n) → ∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) = p ^ m * (a 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, f k / p ^ k)
